title: United Circles JetBlue, American Turns a Bus Into a Jet, and Frontier Locks 60 People Out of Their Own Flight
summary: JetBlue's debt troubles might be setting up the acquisition of a generation for United — we explain why. Plus, American Airlines finally swaps its infamous "flight" that was secretly a bus for actual jets, Frontier leaves 60 passengers stranded because TSA went home, Emirates names three US cities it wants to fly to next, and Airbus's A321XLR brochure numbers don't match what airlines are actually flying.
